descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-24 ER 6; TFA-94745 state 1 · “Each delete asks for confirmation once. No bulk delete.”. Mixed: stated part — cells 4-5: one confirmation for the last patient, then a clear empty state with a way to add patients; our part — double tap (N2), same-text tasks, delete during or right after Generate (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Suggestion N2 · new · not counted as a bug (was S1): Our own extended check (not stated in the UAT or a ticket AC): The double tap is our own case (TC-24/S17 cell 1); the confirm-once line (UAT TC-24 ER, TFA-94699 AC 6) belongs to TFA-94699, in progress; TFA-92579 AC 2 covers patient deletes only, and TFA-94514's one task_deleted per deleted task is correct

A quick double tap on a task's trash icon (Hospital Encounter tab) deletes that task and the next one, with no confirmation and no undo

Tickets: TFA-92579, TFA-94514, TFA-94700, TFA-94745 ready for qa (TC-24); confirm-once rule TFA-94699 AC 6 in progress · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local

Note: Our own check, but data is lost, so it meets Quinn's bar for a bug.

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S17 Delete at the edges: double tap, two tasks with the same text, a delete while a note is generating, and the last patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged as its own analytics event (task completed / task deleted), one per tap, against the chart. (UAT TC-24; UAT OAT-06 item 7; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U9 No bulk delete anywhere in the app: records are deleted one at a time, and there is no 'delete all patients' or similar control. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94699 AC 4)
  • U7 Deleting a patient asks for confirmation exactly once: tapping the card's trash icon opens a pop-up designed like the app UI that says what deleting does, with Cancel and OK; Cancel keeps everything. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-92579 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • T3 No state a delete leads to shows a blank screen, a crash or a raw error: a deleted patient's chart link, the emptied patient list, a patient deleted while its note is generating, and a second device … (TFA-94745 AC 2; UAT Empty & Failure States)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Fresh physician. Hospital list: the fixture patient with five open tasks in a fixed order (two with the same text); control 'QA Hosp Keep <tag>'; 'QA Hosp Busy <tag>' with encounter text and a metoprolol row; 'QA Hosp Gone <tag>' with encounter text

When (1) Fixture patient, Encounter tab: double-click the delete control of 'Recheck BMP in AM' (double-click OK if asked), then delete the second 'Repeat CBC' once. (2) 'QA Hosp Busy': press Generate Note & Finish and, while it is generating, remove the metoprolol row; wait for the note. …

Then (1) Only the tapped task and one 'Repeat CBC' are gone; the task that slid into place stays; two task-deleted events, one per deleted task. (2) The note lands; whether it names metoprolol is recorded for Q12. (3) 'QA Hosp Gone' is gone at once and stays gone: no note or row is written for it later, and the screen shows the list, not an error or a blank page …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94514 AC 2 (one event per tap), TFA-92579 AC 2/7 (one record per delete, asks once, hard delete), TFA-94745 AC 2 (no blank screen) and the 'Empty patient list' row of the UAT's Empty & Failure States. oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Backend reads (local stack): exactly two task_deleted for the fixture chart and 'Repeat CBC' stored exactly once; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)
